caveats: All state cells are updated each frame. No selective-update or sparsity speedup is claimed.
Own frozen Pillar encoder, observation/context, recurrent update, readout and heads only; no old GRU, ResNet or multiscale decoder.
No teacher execution or teacher state in validation/inference. Model timing excludes IO/voxelization/postprocess.
Concurrent training throughput is not a paired latency benchmark. Use independent same-GPU sequential evaluation after training.
Fixed-weight evaluation on seen training data, without optimizer updates; train/val distribution differences prevent assigning a gap to overfitting alone.
scope: Full training-split fit diagnostic; not validation AP
timing_scope: Synchronized model, including FM/warp/gate/cache/crops/decoder/head; excludes IO, voxelization, postprocess; instrumentation included
